verdict.rationale: Sierra agents connect to customers' backend systems. The docs cite systems integrations, inspectable API calls, a record of "systems accessed" behind each answer, and voice agents that use customer context and memory for real-time resolutions. A community hands-on account confirms agents being wired to customers' internal APIs, so answers are grounded in live data, not only help-center knowledge. Missing for 10: explicit documented examples of retrieving plan, order status or account history; detail on integration connectors and data freshness; independent evidence beyond a single anecdote.
